correctness.rationale: From the actual RESULT.md at the frozen source blob, probability of a retained-marker trace 0^u10^v equals a common p^(u+v+1)(1-p)^(n-u-v-1) factor times binomial(i-1,u)binomial(n-i,v), or binomial(i,u)binomial(n-i-1,v). Thus the joint-support likelihood ratio cancels p and has sign iv-(n-i)u; traces without a 1 cancel. A common Bin(i,p)xBin(n-i,p) reference density yields the first exact TV expectation. Coupling endpoint Bernoulli digits and unimodality of hypergeometric masses yields the maximum-coefficient formula. Central binomial convolution, the lattice local CLT and a concentrated Taylor expansion give the fixed-p sharp TV and Hellinger constants; product affinity tensorizes. The exact-rational independently written mask test checked every adjacent shift n=2..7 for p=1/3,2/3; this finite check is not the proof.
